get.description: Consumes a one-use OAuth state and redirects to a clean local completion page. No Q bearer token or plugin token in redirect URLs.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque expiring session token; native clients keep it in SecureStore.

handle.description: Trimmed and lowercased; 3–24 ASCII letters/digits/underscore. xiaoq reserved.

messages.description: At most 24000 Unicode characters in total. Last role must be user. No client system messages, tools, credentials or provider URLs.

AiChatRequest.description: Authenticated chat. Plugin mode requires thinking=false. The server reads tools and saved invocation results for the current user; clients never supply tool results. At most eight completed invocation IDs from the selected connection.
